title: FieldBindingSet
description: Per-origin, per-intake map from each field of the translated contract to where it is read in the origin's own payload. What translation-dictionary.schema.json does for values, this does for fields: without it an origin can only be added in code. Fields the pipeline itself stamps — event_id, tenant_id, source, version, dictionary_version, received_at — are never bound here. See domain/acl/itsm.md#adicionar-uma-origem.

source.description: The origin system itself, named by the customer, e.g. 'service_now'.

intake.description: Which translated contract these bindings feed — incident-alert.schema.json or condition-monitor.schema.json.

bindings.description: One entry per bindable field of the contract this intake feeds. A required field left unbound is a configuration the translator refuses.

field.description: Property name in the translated contract, e.g. 'external_id'.

path.description: Dotted path into the origin's payload, e.g. 'fields.status.name'. Null leaves the field unbound: the translated line carries null, or the event is refused when the contract requires the field.
